about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Trusted Partner in Industrial Gas Solutions
about.description: PT Surya Inti Gas is an industrial gas provider company that has been operating since 2003. We are committed to providing high-quality gas solutions with premium service to support industrial needs in Indonesia.
about.intro: Surya Inti Gas has been established since 2003 and has grown into a trusted industrial and medical gas distributor serving over 150 customers in East Java, Central Java, DIY, and East Kalimantan.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To become a growing company with branches in major cities throughout Indonesia, capable of fulfilling and supporting industrial gas needs domestically as well as serving medical oxygen needs in all hospitals across Indonesia.

mission.title: Mission
items: Able to provide sufficient products with high standards.
Have strong and solid human resources.
Able to fulfill customer needs and desires quickly, accurately, and well.

items.label: Establishment
items.text: Established as CV. Surya Inti Gas, office located at Jl. KH. Mukmin, Sidoarjo, East Java.

items.label: Expansion
items.text: Business grew rapidly, office moved to Meiko Abadi Industrial & Warehousing Complex, Gedangan, Sidoarjo.

items.label: New Head Office
items.text: Office moved to Safe N Lock Complex, Jl. Lingkar Timur KM 5.5, Rangkah Kidul as Head Office.

items.label: PT & Branch
items.text: Officially established as PT. Surya Inti Gas and opened first branch in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan.

product.title: Our Products
product.subtitle: High-Quality Gas Solutions
product.description: We provide various types of industrial and medical gases with international quality standards.

oxygen.title: Oxygen (O₂)
oxygen.description: Industrial and medical oxygen gas with high purity.
oxygen.safety: Keep away from fire sources. Store in well-ventilated area. Use appropriate regulator.

nitrogen.title: Nitrogen (N₂)
nitrogen.description: Nitrogen gas for preservation, welding, and industrial applications.
nitrogen.safety: Inert gas but can cause asphyxiation in enclosed spaces. Ensure adequate ventilation.

argon.title: Argon (Ar)
argon.description: Argon gas for TIG welding and specialty applications.
argon.safety: Inert gas. Avoid accumulation in confined spaces. Store cylinders upright.

acetylene.title: Acetylene (C₂H₂)
acetylene.description: Acetylene gas for metal cutting and welding.
acetylene.safety: Flammable gas. Store away from heat sources. Do not tilt or drop.

installation.title: Gas & Pipe Installation
installation.description: Safe and standard-compliant industrial and medical gas pipe installation. Includes pipeline planning, fitting installation, and gas distribution system leak testing.

tanks.title: Tank Installation
tanks.description: Installation of pressurized gas storage tanks and cryogenic tanks for large-scale industrial needs. Equipped with safety systems, pressure regulators, and commissioning by certified technicians.

hero.title: Career

search.title: Find Openings
search.description: Discover positions that match your skills and interests.

salesExecutive.title: Sales Executive – Industrial Gas
salesExecutive.description: Responsible for industrial gas sales to manufacturing and processing clients. Build long-term relationships with customers and achieve monthly targets.
requirements: Have personal vehicle & Driver's License A/C

installationTechnician.title: Gas Installation Technician
installationTechnician.description: Perform gas pipe installation, regulator installation, and commissioning of gas distribution systems at industrial and medical client locations.
requirements: SMK Technical / D3 Mechanical or related
Willing to work in the field

adminFinanceStaff.title: Administration & Finance Staff
adminFinanceStaff.description: Manage daily administration, simple bookkeeping, and coordination of company operational documents.
requirements: D3/Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Management

gasDeliveryDriver.title: Gas Delivery Driver
gasDeliveryDriver.description: Responsible for timely and safe delivery of gas cylinders to customers, and maintaining vehicle fleet condition.
